text:
olivia_cs: Everline Insurance submitted a request to onboard a claims NER for names, policy_ids, provider_ids, ICD codes. They require PHI residency and asked about HSM and customer-managed KMS. Renewal in ~6w — they want a safety + deployment plan. Can ENG/SAFETY/SRE advise? :wave:

matt_eng: Do they have span-labeled data (JSONL) or doc-level tags? If spans, we can run quick eval. My recommendation: start with quantized 7B on Dedicated; escalate to 13B only if recall/safety fail.

hema_safety: Need a formal PHI definition and a 100-example unredacted/redacted sample for leakage checks. Proposed gates: per-label F1 >= 0.90 for core PHI, phi_leak_rate < 0.5%. Also plan adversarial prompt tests and redaction fallback.

jules_sre: Sizing Qs: what's expected peak qps and typical sequence length? For <4 qps and <512 tokens, Dedicated 7B-quant should meet p95 <500ms with 1 A100 + autoscale. Private + HSM requires their infra spec.

ida_enable: I'll run a 45m onboarding workshop and produce a validation checklist + demo notebook. Recommend ML engineer + security attend. I'll prep runbook for redaction fallback and manual review.

olivia_cs: They have ~6k span-labeled examples in JSONL. Peak 2-3 qps, seq ~220-350 tokens. Sample will be uploaded to their secured bucket today and shared to our VPC. Please advise timeline for AB evals.

matt_eng: Once sample's in our VPC I'll run 7B-quant vs 13B-fp16 on 200 examples and report entity F1 + phi_leak_rate; expect ~48-72h for initial results.

hema_safety: I'll add pass/fail criteria and request a 25-record manual review for edge cases. Also add Console alerts for SSN/policy-number regex matches.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-8344 created: "Everline claims NER - PHI residency & onboarding" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-8344

olivia_cs: Thanks team — ENG to run AB evals, SAFETY to prep adversarial tests, SRE to tentatively hold Dedicated capacity. Scheduling workshop Thu 10AM PT. Looping Sales for renewal touchpoint. :lock:
